info.name: CollabFlow Platform
info.description:
Org → Workspace → Project → Task → Notifications → Invitations/Comments via gateway (:8080).

Needs: auth, platform, task-service (:8083), **collab-service (:9081)**, Kafka.

Folder 8: start collab first, then assign a task → list notifications.
Folder 9: invitations (invite otherUserEmail) + comments with @userId mention.
